ci.toml:
# ci.toml -- this repository's CI contract, checked by ci-lint (zackees/ci.yml
# schema 3, docs/ci-toml.md at the pin below). It generates no YAML: it bounds
# what .github/workflows/*.yaml may do, and the cache janitor
# (.github/workflows/ci-pre.yml) deletes every cache that matches no
# cache family below. Add a family before adding a cache key.
schema = 3
profile = "obs-rust"
linter = "zackees/ci.yml@1a970f01574447d681571ff3d0b8de56cb983dcc"

# -- Platforms ----------------------------------------------------------------
# The platforms PR CI builds and tests natively (build-project.yaml).
[platforms]
linux-x64 = { target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", runs-on = "ubuntu-26.04", group = "linux" }
windows-x64 = { target = "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", runs-on = "windows-2025-vs2026", group = "windows" }
macos-arm64 = { target = "aarch64-apple-darwin", runs-on = "macos-26", group = "macos" }

# -- Suites (docs/rust-port/testing-policy.md) -------------------------------
[suites]
lint = { run = "uv run ci/local_gate.py --lane lint", required = true }
rust = { run = "uv run ci/local_gate.py --lane rust-test", required = true }
tier2 = { run = "uv run ci/local_gate.py --lane tier2-linux", required = true }
sanitizers = { run = "rust/tools/sanitize/sanitize.sh", gating = false }

# -- Flows --------------------------------------------------------------------
[flow.pr]
platforms = ["linux-x64"]
suites = ["lint", "rust", "tier2"]

[flow.main]
extends = "pr"
cache = "write"

[flow.release]
platforms = "all"
suites = "all"
publish = "none"

[flow.nightly]
extends = "release"
schedule = "daily"
cache = "write"
janitor = true

[tags]
ci-full = { add = { platforms = "all" } }

# -- Caches -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Only default-branch runs save (write-on); PRs and merge groups restore, so there is
# no PR delta layer. Sizes: the largest live entry of each family
# (gh api repos/obs-rust/obs-studio/actions/caches, 2026-10-15), rounded up.
[cache]
budget = "10GB"
write-on = ["main", "nightly"]
pr = { mode = "none", families = [], max-per-pr = "0MB", budget = "0MB", trim = "on-close" }

# The janitor deletes any cache matching no family. evict = "lru" families
# keep their most recently used entries up to max x cardinality.
[cache.family]
# zackees/setup-soldr (build-project.yaml, release-rust.yaml).
registry = { via = "setup-soldr:cargo-registry", max = "60MB", per = "platform" }
# Linux retains measured dev (~622 MB) and release (~637 MB) snapshots.
deps = { via = "setup-soldr:cook", max = "900MB", evict = "lru", shapes = { linux = { max = "1.4GB" }, macos = { max = "400MB" }, windows = { max = "650MB" } } }
# Embedded compiler-store transport is disabled at every setup-soldr callsite.
# No family: legacy setup-soldr-buildcache-v2-* entries may be reclaimed.
toolchain = { via = "setup-soldr:solo-toolchain", max = "190MB", per = "platform" }
soldr-mini = { via = "setup-soldr:soldr-mini", max = "15MB", per = "platform" }
# astral-sh/setup-uv's own cache.
uv = { via = "setup-uv", max = "50MB" }
# First-match classification: keep this specific prefix before zccache-.
# Queue OFF/ON objects share one measured ~475 MB archive. Independent LRU
# protection prevents newer nightly writes from evicting that queue seed.
zccache-tier2 = { prefix = "zccache-tier2-linux-", max = "550MB", evict = "lru" }
# Nightly Ubuntu/AppImage/sanitizer objects keep their pooled allowance.
# Combined with Tier 2 this is 1650 MiB, down from the old 1700 MiB.
zccache = { prefix = "zccache-", max = "500MB", evict = "lru", shapes = { ubuntu = { max = "400MB" }, appimage = { max = "400MB" }, sanitize = { max = "300MB" } } }
# Windows compiler cache: ccache as cl.exe (build-project.yaml windows-build).
windows-ccache = { prefix = "windows-ccache-", max = "800MB", evict = "lru" }
# macOS: Xcode's compilation cache (build-project.yaml macos-build).
xcode = { prefix = "macOS-xcode-", max = "500MB", evict = "lru" }
# Flatpak: flatpak-builder's dependency cache and its SDK ccache.
flatpak-builder = { prefix = "flatpak-builder-", max = "2.5GB", evict = "lru" }
flatpak-ccache = { prefix = "flatpak-ccache-", max = "200MB" }
# AppImage (appimage.yaml): cargo, apt and the test images' packages.
appimage-cargo = { prefix = "cargo-appimage-", max = "500MB", evict = "lru" }
appimage-apt = { prefix = "apt-appimage-", max = "250MB" }
appimage-testpkgs = { prefix = "testpkgs-", max = "250MB" }
# Known CodeQL overlay bases: observed C++ ~131 MB and Python ~11 MB.
# Automatic default setup is disabled; scans run nightly in scheduled.yaml.
# Retain bounded known keys rather than letting maintenance delete them as unknown.
codeql-overlay = { prefix = "codeql-overlay-base-database-", max = "200MB", evict = "lru" }
# services-validator action.
service-check = { prefix = "service-check-", max = "1MB" }
# Transitional: the ccache keys master's Tier 2 and AppImage jobs restore
# until #957 (zccache) merges. Delete both once master saves zccache-*.
tier2-ccache = { prefix = "tier2-ccache-linux-", max = "110MB" }
# Tier 2's apt downloads (#1055) and the per-target Linux plugin builds' ccache.
tier2-apt = { prefix = "tier2-apt-", max = "400MB" }
targets-ccache = { prefix = "targets-ccache-linux-", max = "300MB" }
# Host package archive: measured ~147 MB; isolated from container package versions.
targets-apt = { prefix = "targets-apt-", max = "200MB", evict = "lru" }
# Added on master after #957 was written.
tier2-ctest-cost = { prefix = "tier2-ctest-cost-", max = "1MB" }
windows-tier2-ccache = { prefix = "windows-tier2-ccache-", max = "800MB", evict = "lru" }
macos-tier2-xcas = { prefix = "macos-tier2-xcas-", max = "500MB", evict = "lru" }
# Measured warm archive ~1.11 GB; the job bounds ccache to 1200M before save.
qt-ccache = { prefix = "qt-ccache-linux-", max = "1.3GB", evict = "lru" }
vcpkg-cmocka = { prefix = "vcpkg-bin-cmocka-", max = "100MB" }
libs-qt = { prefix = "libs-qt-", max = "1GB" }
libs-ffmpeg = { prefix = "libs-ffmpeg-", max = "500MB" }
appimage-ccache = { prefix = "ccache-appimage-", max = "100MB" }

# -- Local runs (local-gate.toml) --------------------------------------------
[local]
runner = "bosn-act"
lanes = ["lint", "rust-test", "cross", "tier2-linux"]
cache = "machine"

# -- Allowlists ---------------------------------------------------------------
[allow]
workflows = { "ci.yml" = ["workflow_dispatch", "pull_request", "merge_group"], "ci-pre.yml" = ["workflow_call"], "push.yaml" = ["push"], "build-project.yaml" = ["workflow_call"], "analyze-project.yaml" = ["workflow_call"], "check-format.yaml" = ["workflow_call"], "sign-windows.yaml" = ["workflow_call"], "appimage.yaml" = ["push", "workflow_call", "workflow_dispatch"], "claim-bot.yaml" = ["issue_comment", "schedule", "workflow_dispatch"], "dispatch.yaml" = ["workflow_dispatch"], "leaderboard.yml" = ["schedule", "workflow_dispatch"], "publish.yaml" = ["release"], "release-rust.yaml" = ["schedule", "workflow_dispatch"], "sanitizers.yaml" = ["workflow_dispatch", "schedule"], "scheduled.yaml" = ["workflow_dispatch", "schedule"] }
actions = [
  "actions/attest", "actions/cache", "actions/checkout", "actions/download-artifact", "actions/upload-artifact",
  "andriivitiv/setup-steamcmd", "andriivitiv/steam-totp", "astral-sh/setup-uv", "cloudflare/wrangler-action",
  "flatpak/flatpak-github-actions", "github/codeql-action", "google-github-actions/auth",
  "korelstar/xmllint-problem-matcher", "obsproject/obs-crowdin-sync", "obsproject/obs-studio",
  "peter-evans/create-pull-request", "softprops/action-gh-release", "totaldebug/sphinx-publish-action",
  "yuzutech/annotations-action", "zackees/ci.yml", "zackees/setup-soldr",
]
tools = ["soldr", "uv", "uvx", "python3", "cmake", "docker", "git", "gh"]
# Release signing, publishing and service keys the upstream OBS workflows use.
secrets = [
  "CF_ACCOUNT_ID", "CF_API_TOKEN", "CHECK_SERVERS_API_KEY", "CHECK_SERVERS_LIST", "CROWDIN_SYNC_CROWDIN_PAT",
  "CROWDIN_SYNC_GITHUB_PAT", "FLATHUB_BETA_TOKEN", "FLATHUB_TOKEN", "GCP_IDENTITY_POOL", "GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_NAME",
  "GCS_ACCESS_KEY_ID", "GCS_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET", "GPU_PRIORITY_VAL", "MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD",
  "MACOS_NOTARIZATION_PASSWORD", "MACOS_NOTARIZATION_USERNAME", "MACOS_SIGNING_CERT", "MACOS_SIGNING_CERT_PASSWORD",
  "MACOS_SIGNING_IDENTITY", "MACOS_SIGNING_PROVISIONING_PROFILE", "PVS_KEY", "PVS_NAME", "RESTREAM_CLIENTID",
  "RESTREAM_HASH", "SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY", "STEAM_PASSWORD", "STEAM_SHARED_SECRET", "STEAM_USER", "TWITCH_CLIENT_ID",
  "TWITCH_HASH", "YOUTUBE_CLIENTID", "YOUTUBE_CLIENTID_HASH", "YOUTUBE_SECRET", "YOUTUBE_SECRET_HASH",
]
permissions = { "actions: write" = ["cache-janitor", "ci-pre"] }
# setup-soldr is called from the workflows directly; there is no wrapper.
setup-soldr = { only-in = ".github/workflows", require = {} }
# Host-specific Rust code lives in each crate's src/platform/ (one cfg_select!
# in platform/mod.rs) or src/ffi/, enforced by the repo Dylint
# dylints/ban_platform_cfg_outside_boundary (AGENTS.md, testing-policy.md).
# Tests, the C oracle and the tools are exempt there too.
platform-selector = "rust/obs-util/src/platform/mod.rs"
platform-code = ["rust/*/src/platform/**", "rust/*/src/ffi/**", "rust/*/tests/**", "rust/*/benches/**", "rust/*/build.rs", "rust/obs-c-oracle/**", "rust/tools/**", "dylints/**"]

[publish]
pypi = { auth = "none", environment = "none", mode = "none" }
